title: Paragraph Reverser
description: Reverse the order of paragraphs, lines or words in any text — a handy trick for editing and proofreading.
howto: Paste your text into the box.
Choose a mode: reverse paragraph order, reverse lines, or reverse words inside each paragraph.
Copy the reversed result with one click.

faqs.a: Reading a draft backwards (last paragraph first) breaks your familiarity with it, so typos and awkward phrasing jump out — a classic proofreading trick.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the modes?
faqs.a: "Paragraphs" flips whole blocks separated by blank lines. "Lines" flips every line. "Words" keeps paragraph order but reverses the word order inside each one.
No. Everything happens in your browser; the text never leaves your device.
